title: Tenshō-Jingo war
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Tenshō-Jingo war", at revision 1370749935, opens: "Tenshō-Jingo War  or more simply, the Battle of Jingo , was a three-way military conflict in 1582 AD between Hōjō clan, Tokugawa clan, and Uesugi clan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10939819, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1582 battle in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
